audit.why: HARD 8/10 fits: 47.59% WR over 7040 games, Syndra bullies pre-6 but Fizz's R+E all-in and untargetable hop own the post-6 kill windows. Diff/tone consistent.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer had Fizz on all seven chart rows while content win[] had Syndra on all seven — every full-layer why described Syndra winning under a Fizz side. Packet also flags its own 7/7 Syndra chart against the 47.59% WR.
audit.why: Kit-grounded reconciliation: melee Fizz cannot answer 800-range Q pre-6 (rows 0-3 Syndra), level 6 is his R+E danger window (row 4 Fizz — both layers' own prose calls it 'the danger window'), Zhonya's/first item flips the all-in back and late-game burst still one-shots him on a landed E (rows 5-6 Syndra, matching content whys).
audit.corrected: Sides 0-3, 5-6 moved to Syndra (win[] already Syndra there, side edits alone with rewritten whys); row 4 stays Fizz with win[4] moved to Fizz and both whys rewritten. All rows proposed as one atomic group.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no numbers; two copy-paste-bleed bullets; the Seastone Trident auto-reset burst tell (missingInteractions) was absent; enemyWin was a name-swap template.
audit.why: Fizz E is 16/14/12/10/8s, Q dash 8s rank 1 — both down he has no way in. His W is an auto reset, so the wind-up is the step-back cue.
audit.corrected: Numbers added, bleed bullets replaced with the auto-reset tell and Q-vs-E cooldown maths, enemyWin grounded in his stun-dodge plus pre-Zhonya's all-in.

edits.before: Q on every last-hit he takes — your level 1 poke is the best in the mage pool. Leave spheres on the ground; they're ammo.
edits.after: Fizz is melee — he eats a Q on every last-hit he takes. Your level 1 poke is the best in the mage pool; grounded spheres are ammo.

edits.before: Q-E already threatens the stun — most mids don't respect it at 2 and pay a Flash for the lesson.
edits.after: Q-E already threatens the stun — Fizz has no ranged answer at 2 and steps up to farm at his own risk.

edits.before: Full kit: W-slow into QE stun into Q again is a half-bar rotation. The lane is yours to bully from here.
edits.after: Full kit: W-slow into QE stun into Q again is a half-bar rotation on a melee Fizz whose E is still 16s.

edits.before: Splinter stacks build toward empowered Q — keep poking; every sphere thrown is scaling AND pressure at once.
edits.after: Splinter stacks build toward empowered Q — keep poking the melee farm; every sphere is scaling AND pressure.

edits.before: Unleashed Power online — count spheres before every trade: three-plus on the field means most mids die to R alone.
edits.after: His 6 is the danger window: Chum the Waters plus the untargetable hop can delete you — trade only with E up.

edits.before: Your stun and Zhonya's let you bait his hop and flip his level 6 R all-in.
edits.after: At 6 his Chum the Waters plus hop all-in kills you before your E lands.

edits.before: Luden's spike: QE-stun into full rotation deletes squishies. Force the wave contact trades he cannot refuse.
edits.after: Zhonya's/Luden's spike: stone through his commit, then QE-R as his hop ends — his all-in becomes your kill.

edits.before: Late Syndra is a one-button court-martial: flank, QE the carry, R the verdict. Spheres on the ground are sentences waiting.
edits.after: Late, your burst still one-shots him the instant E connects — ward flanks, hold the stun, and his pick game starves.

edits.before: Fizz wins by landing Playful / Trickster, denying your pattern, and cashing the all-in before your pattern matures.
edits.after: Fizz wins by dodging your stun with Playful / Trickster, then cashing the R-E all-in before your Zhonya's is online.

edits.before: - Fizz Playful / Trickster: matchup-defining — The untargetable hop dodges your whole combo — bait it before spending your burst. Check it before every step-up. - E Scatter the Weak is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Fizz Playful / Trickster (E): 16s at rank 1, 8s max — the untargetable hop dodges your whole combo; bait it before spending burst. - His Q dash is 8s: both down, he cannot reach you at all. - E Scatter the Weak is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it.

edits.before: Q the last-hit, W-slow the dodge attempt, QE the slowed line, Q again — a full bar of damage that started as routine poke.
edits.after: His burst opens with a Seastone Trident auto reset — the wind-up, not the cast, is your cue to E him off before Q lands.

edits.before: Spending E on chip-spacing and then watching the dash you bought it for arrive unanswered — the stun is the matchup, not the damage.
edits.after: His Q dash is 8 seconds to your E's 15 — chase past your stun and the next hop-Q lands with nothing left to answer it.

notes: Full layer had Fizz on all 7 rows against content's Syndra on all 7 — full-layer whys all described Syndra winning, so the sides were the corrupt half on rows 0-3/5-6; row 4 (Level 6) is Fizz's window per both layers' own prose and the 47.59% WR, so there content win[4] was moved instead. Ratings left untouched to avoid inventing magnitudes. Seastone Trident auto-reset tell added from missingInteractions. Packet's own defect note flags its 7/7 Syndra chart as contradicting the WR — my chart is grounded in the kits, not the packet chart.
